evidence.note: A framework paper that formalizes test-time scaling as budgeted inference over a model's implicit prefix tree, splits it into three structural regimes (single-trajectory, leaf-level, prefix-level), replaces scalar repeated-sampling metrics with a discovery-stability profile that Pass@k and its relatives are coordinates of, specifies exact-replay versus distributional reproducibility, and releases 1,948,821 full reasoning traces with token-level alternatives and two verifier signals.
evidence.title: Test-Time Scaling in Reasoning LLMs: Inference Regimes, Evaluation, and Reproducibility

evidence.note: ARM trains a model to pick among four reasoning formats (Direct Answer, Short CoT, Code, Long CoT) per task using Ada-GRPO, cutting average tokens by about 30% at roughly unchanged accuracy.
evidence.title: ARM: Adaptive Reasoning Model

evidence.note: Routes queries between a thinking and a non-thinking model with a threshold that is adjusted online by a betting supermartingale, so the accumulated statistical evidence certifies at any stopping time that the accuracy given up stays under a user-specified tolerance.
evidence.title: Anytime Safe PAC Efficient Reasoning

evidence.note: ShorterBetter takes the length of the shortest correct response in a sampled group as a per-problem target and rewards the model for matching it, cutting output length by 50%-80% on DeepSeek-Distill-Qwen-1.5B/7B.
evidence.title: ShorterBetter: Guiding Reasoning Models to Find Optimal Inference Length for Efficient Reasoning
